caption:
⚔️ Digital Bridge 2023 hosted the largest battle of IT startups - Astana Hub Battle.

More than 200 IT companies from Central Eurasia took part in the battle, competing for a total prize fund of $125,000.
100 of the most competitive projects made it to the semi-finals of the battle, of which 10 were selected to battle in the finals: Garderob, Cleek, MyMind, Porte, ProsperPay, Qtap, Beksar, TrustContract, IMPRO, MyStory.

🏆 This year, the winners of the Astana Hub Battle were determined in five categories, each of which received $25,000:

⭐️ Best Social Impact - MyMind, aimed at detecting dementia in its early stages.
⭐️ The Most Innovative - Qtap, a platform offering impressive functionality of a social network, website builder and online payments in a single ecosystem.
⭐️ Exponential Growth - Beksar, which provides the ability to digitize point-of-sale data using a laptop or smartphone.
⭐️ Best AI Startup - MyStory, specializing in creating personalized fairy tales using artificial intelligence.
⭐️ Most Investable Startup - Porte, replacing magnetic keys with digital ones in hotels.

🏅Also at the Astana Hub Battle, the Shabyt project, created by schoolchildren from Astana, earned the People’s  award in the amount of 1 million tenge. Their development - the AIDAHAR robot, equipped with artificial intelligence, is capable of effectively extinguishing fires in hard-to-reach places.

👏 Congratulations to all participants on their victory and wish success to startups!
